questions.question: Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word. Dermatologist : Skin : Neonatologist : ?
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

Dermatologist : Skin : Neonatologist : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Dermatologist is a doctor who studies and treats skin diseases.

So Dermatologist is related to Skin.

Similarly,

Neonatologist is a doctor who diagnose and treat newborns baby or Infants.

So Neonatologist is related to Infants.

Hence, "option 2" is the correct answer.

Key Points

  • Neonatology is a subspecialty of pediatrics that consists of the medical care of newborn infants, especially the ill or premature newborns.
  • It is a hospital-based specialty and is usually practiced in neonatal intensive care units.
  • A neonatal intensive care unit (NICU), also known as an intensive care nursery (ICN), is an intensive care unit (ICU) specializing in the care of ill or premature newborn infants.
  • Neonatal refers to the first 28 days of life.
  • Neonatal care, as known as specialized nurseries or intensive care, has been around since the 1960s.
  • The first American newborn intensive care unit, designed by Louis Gluck, was opened in October 1960 at Yale-New Haven Hospital.​

Additional Information 

Important Study Description
Kalology Kalology is the study of facial beauty and the way in which our beauty affects our lifestyle and role in society.
Gynaecology Gynaecology or gynaecology is the medical practice dealing with the health of the female reproductive system.
Cytology

Cytology, the study of cells.

Here relation between animals and their sound is given.

Horses : Neigh → The sound made by horse is called neigh. (Animal – sound)

1) Bears : Roar → A lion roars, the sound of a bear is called growl.

2) Elephants : Whine → The sound made by elephant is called trumpet, while the sound made by mosquitoes is called whine.

3) Donkeys : Chortle → The sound made by kangaroos is called chortle, while donkeys make hee-haw bray sound.

So, only ‘Camels : Grunt’ shows the same relation as ‘Horses : Neigh’.

Hence, ‘Camels : Grunt’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the option in which the words share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of words. Faculty : Teachers
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option in which the words share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of words.

Faculty : Teachers
questions.solution:
Faculty : Teachers → The faculty is described as a group of teachers. (Collective noun)

Similarly,

1) Ants ; Flock → A group of ants is called a colony. So this is not an example of collective noun.

2) Colony : Wolves → A group of wolves is called a pack. So this is not an example of collective noun.

3) Galaxy : Apartments → A group of apartments is called a block. So this is not an example of collective noun.

4) Fleet : Trucks → A group of trucks is called a fleet. So this is an example of collective noun.

Hence, ‘Fleet : Trucks’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the option in which the words share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of words. Tissues : Histology
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option in which the words share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of words.

Tissues : Histology
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Tissues : Histology → Histology is the branch of biology which studies the tissues.

Option (1) Insects : Malacology → Malacology is the branch of invertebrate zoology that deals with the study of the Mollusca.

Option (2) Amphibians : Herpetology → Herpetology is the branch of zoology dealing with reptiles and amphibians.

Option (3) Shells : Ornithology →  Ornithology is a branch of zoology dealing with birds.

Option (4) Mountains : Onomatology → Onomatology is a branch of science which relates to the rules to be observed in the formation of names or terms.

Hence, ‘Amphibians : Herpetology’ is the correct answer.

The logic followed here is:

Mosquito : Swarm → A group of mosquito is called swarm.

Similarly,

Shark : School → A group of shark is called school.

Hence, ‘Shark : School’ is the correct answer. 

Additional Information

  • A group of snakes is called den or pit.
  • A group of cats is called a clowder. 
  • A group of Monkey is called a barrel or a troop.
  • A group of Lion is called pride.
